WELCOME, CHEF.

Your first day, made easy.

01 / PIZZA

A really good pizza

Pick a ticket → dough → tomato sauce → mozzarella → requested toppings → bake → wait 7 seconds → collect the pizza → serve.

02 / BURGER

A really good burger

Grill a patty → wait 5 seconds → collect it. At the burger station, add a bottom bun, cooked patty, and requested toppings. Finish with the top bun and serve.

Two ways to play

Free practice has unlimited customer patience and no burnt food. A shift lasts 3 minutes. Customers wait 95 seconds; food burns if left cooking for 10 seconds after it is ready. Serve quickly for more points.

Keyboard shortcuts

1–6: add ingredients · P / B: pizza / burger station · Enter: serve · Space: pause. Tab moves between buttons. Match the recipe exactly; missing or extra ingredients mean starting over.

 BUILDING THE NEXT CHAPTER

A foundation for the next kitchen.

This is an isometric Canvas prototype. Orders, recipes, cooking state, patience, scoring, and timing run independently of the visuals. Desktop and touch inputs use the same action interface.

Input layerPointer / keyboard / touch↓Game logicSemantic actions → state machine → orders and scoring↓Scene and interfaceKitchen / food / feedback / sound

Next: add a 3D scene and XR input adapter, mapping ingredient grabs, griddle placement, and oven interactions to the same actions. Headset tracking and physical grabbing are not implemented yet.
